title: Add deterministic probe harness and condensed impact brief generator
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: Motivation: onboarding and staged rollouts occasionally lack compact, actionable release notes that explain perf regressions or improvements tied to model metadata changes. This PR introduces a deterministic micro-probe harness and a condensed impact-brief generator that together produce repeatable micro-profiles (latency, token-cost, KV-hit-rate) and a human-readable impact summary for changelogs and release assemblers. Design: the harness runs a seeded, constrained set of probes derived from model profiles and representative prompt seeds; probes are sampled deterministically with stratified seeds to cover cold/warm KV states, short/long context and streaming vs non-streaming paths. The condensed brief generator consumes probe outputs and telemetry diffs, applies heuristics (thresholds configurable per-profile) to produce 3–5 bullet impact statements, a regression/upgrade score, suggested rollback triggers, and a short remediation checklist. Implementation highlights: - deterministic-sampler module (seeded RNG + stratified bucketing) - microbench runner that exercises compile/kernel variants and caches (short scripts under tests/probes) - brief-generator with templates and severity heuristics integrated into release-assembler hooks - lightweight CLI and a release-assembler plugin that can emit draft release snippets to the changelog queue. Rollout: feature behind opt-in flag (registry.probes.enabled) with staged rollout to model owners, then enabled for onboarding CI. Backwards compatibility: no schema changes to existing model profiles; probe outputs are attached as artifacts and referenced by profile.metadata.probe_snapshot (string link). See checklist below.

release_notes: Add deterministic micro-probe harness that produces repeatable probe artifacts for each model onboarding.
Introduce condensed impact brief generator that synthesizes 3–5 human-readable impact bullets, a regression/upgrade score, and suggested rollback guidance for changelogs.
Feature is opt-in behind registry.probes.enabled and integrated with release-assembler to emit draft snippets to the changelog queue.
impact_preview: Regression: +18% median token-latency on long-context probes; suggested action: hold rollout and investigate kernel selection.
Improvement: -12% token-cost on short prompts via quantization path; suggested action: promote variant and update profile note.
